reviewScope: Synthetic source-only review of sixteen development tasks, normalized using ADJUDICATION.md and frozen clarification scripts. No records, registry, runtime outputs, ranks, other reviewers, private or heldout content inspected; not live human approval or runtime/agent acceptance.
rankingConvention: Score the final postclarification requested response. Explicit source-supported negative yes/no answers are answerable with defined rank metrics. A missing requested value is unanswerable with undefined factual-answer rank metrics even when bounded-refusal evidence is direct. Relevance and applicability are independent from lifecycle; bundles are minimal sufficient alternatives, not a demand to retrieve every grade-2/3 passage.
